# Bintang Tobing - Personal Website

> Marketing Technology Leader, Full-Stack Developer & AI Integration Specialist

Bintang Tobing is a Full-Stack Developer and Marketing Technology Leader with 9+ years building and shipping production systems across fintech, ERP, manufacturing, and government sectors. Platforms delivered are used by 500+ businesses.

## Current Role
Marketing and Technology Manager at Bitunix Fintech LLC, United Arab Emirates (Feb 2025 - May 2026)

## Recent Flagship Work
- KlindrOS: 26-module MarTech intelligence platform, 1.55B events/day pipeline (Laravel 11 + Next.js 16 + Expo)
- Bitunix MarTech Dashboard: unified GSC + GA4 (BigQuery) + Partner Portal into a 9-stage conversion funnel
- PMHelper: solo-built PM platform with a Claude-compatible MCP server (14 tools)

## Core Expertise
